answer: Every agent posts a 50-credit identity bond decaying 5% each epoch, like a lantern dimming unless honest work refuels it. A sybil operator with 1,000 fake identities pays 50,000 up front, then loses 2,500 per epoch while the fakes sit idle, so the cost never stops. In this cold tundra, unattended identities freeze out. Honest agents wander job to job, pay one bond once, and refill it from earnings, so their rewards are never diluted by fakes.
